name: Supra Trends Limited
about: Supra Trends Limited engages in the manufacture, processing, marketing, distributing, and sale of apparels, footwear and sportswear products, personal wear, dress materials, fabrics, clothes, yarns,0 and other textiles goods in India. The company act as trading agent and undertakes job works. It is also involved in the importing and exporting activities; and offers paper and related products. The company offers its products through shops, malls, or owned showrooms, and franchise shops. The company was formerly known as Vijay Growth Financial Services Limited and changed its name to Supra Trends Limited in January 2014. Supra Trends Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
